description: This file defines the properties for the LoRaWAN protocol adapter, extending HTTP protocol adapter properties and managing a list of tenants authorized to send commands.

classes.name: LoraProtocolAdapterProperties
classes.description: A class that manages LoRaWAN protocol adapter properties, including a list of command-enabled tenants.

methods.name: getCommandEnabledTenants
methods.description: Returns the list of tenants allowed to send commands, as configured in properties.
